prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1213; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of lumbar and thoracic back strain. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury described. Over the course of 18 visits, care followed a typical progression, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, with visit frequency tapering steadily as symptoms improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the lumbar and thoracic paraspinal musculature. No prior injury or treatment involving this body area is known to this provider. Billed services correspond to the care documented in the clinical record, with no duplicated or repeated charges identified. At discharge, the patient demonstrated substantial functional recovery with minimal residual limitation and was released to full activity with instructions to return as needed.
